{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_resched_policy_001", "thread_id": "thread_resched_policy", "from_": "vp.sales@company.example.com", "to": ["sales@company.example.com"], "subject": "Rescheduling Policy - Calendly Events", "date": "2026-02-10T09:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_resched_policy_001
来源：vp.sales@company.example.com
收件人：sales@company.example.com
日期：2026-02-10T09:00:00Z
主题：Rescheduling Policy - Calendly Events
Team,

A few reminders about our rescheduling process:

1. Maximum reschedules: Any event that has already been rescheduled twice or more should be escalated to the manager rather than cancelled again. Check the event description for prior reschedule history.

2. VIP / Locked events: Events with '[LOCKED]' in the name or description are confirmed with a VIP contact and MUST NOT be cancelled or rescheduled under any circumstances. If a VIP event appears in search results, skip it entirely.

3. Match by email domain: When multiple events share the same invitee name, always match on exact email address.

4. CRM updates: After processing a reschedule, update the lead status to 'Working' and create a note with the reschedule details.

Best,
VP of Sales"}
